description: Merge several existing PDFs (given as URLs, in order) into a single PDF. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /pdfsharp/merge.

extraHTTPHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers Api2Pdf forwards when it fetches a source URL (e.g. auth for a protected page/file).

fileName.description: A name for the generated file, e.g. 'invoice.pdf'.

inline.description: If true (Api2Pdf default), the generated file is served inline; if false, as an attachment.

options.description: Engine-specific render options (page size, margins, orientation, headers/footers, etc.). Passed through verbatim to Api2Pdf.

output_binary.description: If true, return the raw file bytes as base64 instead of a FileUrl. Default false (recommended for agents — returns a short-lived link).

storage.description: Custom storage target, used when useCustomStorage is true.

method.description: HTTP method Api2Pdf uses to upload (e.g. 'PUT').

url.description: Pre-signed destination URL for the upload.

urls.description: URLs of the PDFs to merge, in the order they should appear (at least two).

useCustomStorage.description: If true, Api2Pdf uploads the result to your own storage (see `storage`) instead of hosting it.

name: api2pdf_merge_pdfs
title: Merge PDFs (PDFSharp)
